name: Shotgun - Strong left - LTE slant out
call: Shotgun SL Left LTE Slant Out
purpose: A throw the quarterback can make before anybody gets to him: the left tight end slants out flat toward the left sideline, almost on the line of scrimmage, and everybody else but the SL stays in and blocks.

LTE.rule: Take one step up, then slant out flat toward the left sideline, almost along the line of scrimmage. Look for the ball right away.

QB.rule: Catch the snap, take one step and throw to the left tight end as he slants out. If he is covered, tuck it and run.

coaching_points: Everybody but the tight end and the SL pass blocks: step back, hands up, stay between your man and the quarterback.
The slant stays flat — one step up and out, almost on the line of scrimmage. Any deeper and he runs into the linebackers.
The quarterback throws it as soon as the tight end clears the end. If he is covered, tuck it and run — no second look.
